content: @anthropic-ai/sdk v0.105.0 (June 2026). For Deno/Supabase Edge Functions use: import Anthropic from 'npm:@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.105.0'. The npm: specifier is the Supabase-recommended approach over esm.sh CDN as of 2025. Raw fetch alternative works but requires manually handling the Anthropic Messages API protocol. SDK provides TypeScript types, retry logic, and streaming support. Each function needs its own deno.json with the import map. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set as Deno.env.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') in the Edge Function.
